[0] [0]Earlier reports suggested Apple plans to launch a 20th anniversary edition iPhone next year with an all-glass body design. However, analysts at investment bank Jefferies believe the device will no longer move forward.

[1] [1]Wall Street analysts say the major redesign plans for the 20th anniversary iPhone have been shelved.

[2] [2]Wall Street investment bank Jefferies downgraded Apple's stock rating to "underperform" today. Analyst Edison Lee noted that the possible cancellation of the major redesign for the 20th anniversary edition iPhone is one of the main reasons for this downgrade.

[3] [3]The key to this downgrade lies in news that Apple's all-glass iPhone project has been cancelled. Although rumours about the project being in development emerged as early as 2025, with some expecting a 2027 launch, Apple has never responded to such speculation. However, Apple quietly filed a patent for an "all-glass enclosure" as early as 2019. Jefferies previously considered the all-glass iPhone to be reasonable and credible, but Edison Lee believes development has stalled. The analyst pointed out that supply chain investigations show the project was terminated due to poor yield rates. Edison Lee believes that with memory costs soaring, this decision is a "major blow" to driving high-end iPhone sales. He estimates that if the device launched as scheduled in September 2027 to celebrate the iPhone's 20th anniversary, its average retail price would reach US$2,060, higher than the average selling price of any model in history. Edison Lee wrote: "More importantly, we believe Apple originally planned to extend the all-glass design to future iPhone Pro and Pro Max models, thereby further increasing the average selling price and gross margin." He believes that with memory prices rising, this should have been an important defensive strategy.

[4] [4]Edison Lee also pointed out that Apple's artificial intelligence strategy and rising component costs for the iPhone 19 Pro are other reasons for the stock downgrade.

[5] [5]Based on Edison Lee's report, it remains unclear whether the analyst is referring to the entire redesign plan being shelved, or only some design elements being abandoned.

[6] [6]The most liked comment was posted by Currentinterest.

[7] [7]These analysts have been wrong too many times in their predictions about Apple's future plans. Even the concept of an "all-glass" design has never accurately reflected Apple's true intentions. The 20th anniversary edition phone will be unique and creative, and whatever the final design looks like, it will be very popular.

[8] [8]For example, reports circulating for months have pointed out that Apple will not be able to completely remove the Dynamic Island cutout next year. Therefore, an all-glass display is simply impossible. However, the rumoured four-curved-edge bezel design may still be achievable.

[9] [9]In any case, if the redesign of the 20th anniversary edition iPhone has indeed been cancelled, credible media should confirm this news soon.

[10] [10]What are your thoughts on this report about the design of the 20th anniversary iPhone? Feel free to share your opinions in the comments section.
